newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures up on strong Thai offer price.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures up on strong Thai offer price.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended higher across the board on Wednesday, supported by firmer Thai rubber offer prices to Japan and the yen's further slip against the dollar, traders said.
Prices ranged from 1.2 yen to 2.9 yen per kg higher. Benchmark July was up 2.8 yen at 151.1 yen.

The market started the day firmer, carrying over bullish sentiment from the previous day. "The weak yen and a rebound in Thai rubber offer prices stimulated active short-covering," one trader said. "Sentiment improved after the benchmark broke above psychological support of 150 yen per kg," he said.
